"""Revalidate the spreadsheet scope after replacing every selected peel launch."""
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
exec(compile((root/'profile_setup_long.py').read_text(),str(root/'profile_setup_long.py'),'exec'),globals())

cases=json.loads((repo/'docs/hygon-optimization/mm/all-mm-cases.json').read_text())
target_rows={c['row'] for c in json.loads((repo/'docs/hygon-optimization/mm/cases.json').read_text())}

def verify(result,reference,dtype):
    actual=result.cpu().double()
    error=(actual-reference).abs()
    rtol,atol=(1e-10,1e-10) if dtype==torch.float64 else (1e-4,2e-4)
    limit=atol+rtol*reference.abs()
    bad=(~torch.isfinite(actual)) | (error>limit)
    return dict(ok=not bool(bad.any()),bad_elements=int(bad.sum()),total=reference.numel(),
                rtol=rtol,atol=atol,max_abs_error=float(error.max()),
                max_allowed_ratio=float((error/limit).max()))

def input_for(meta,seed):
    dtype=getattr(torch,meta['dtype'].split('.')[-1])
    shape,stride,offset=meta['shape'],meta['stride'],meta.get('storage_offset',0)
    size=offset+1+sum((n-1)*s for n,s in zip(shape,stride))
    storage=torch.randn(size,dtype=dtype,generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed))
    cpu=storage.as_strided(shape,stride,offset)
    device=storage.to('flagos').as_strided(shape,stride,offset)
    device.requires_grad_(meta.get('requires_grad',False))
    return cpu,device

with open(root/'mm-scope-long-accuracy.jsonl','w',buffering=1) as accuracy_out, open(root/'mm-scope-long-records.jsonl','w',buffering=1) as out:
 for case in cases:
    row=case['row']
    ma,mb=case['metadata'][0]
    if ma['dtype'] not in ['torch.float32','torch.float64']:continue
    dtype=getattr(torch,ma['dtype'].split('.')[-1])
    for seed in [100003,880301]:
        a,aa=input_for(ma,seed+row*2)
        b,bb=input_for(mb,seed+row*2+1)
        reference=a.double()@b.double()
        results={}
        for name,fn in [('das',torch.mm),('new_export',flag_gems.mm)]:
            y=fn(aa,bb)
            torch.flagos.synchronize()
            results[name]=verify(y,reference,dtype)
        record=dict(row=row,seed=seed,shape=[aa.shape[0],bb.shape[1],aa.shape[1]],
                    a_stride=list(aa.stride()),b_stride=list(bb.stride()),a_offset=aa.storage_offset(),
                    b_offset=bb.storage_offset(),requires_grad=[aa.requires_grad,bb.requires_grad],
                    input_dtype=str(dtype),target=row in target_rows,accuracy=results,
                    selected=configs.select_config(aa,bb))
        accuracy_out.write(json.dumps(record)+'\n')
        print('SCOPE_ACCURACY',row,seed,{k:v['ok'] for k,v in results.items()},flush=True)
        if seed!=100003 or row not in target_rows or not all(v['ok'] for v in results.values()):continue
        providers=[('das',torch.mm),('new_export',flag_gems.mm)]
        for _,fn in providers:
            for _ in range(10):fn(aa,bb)
        torch.flagos.synchronize()
        for aa_round in range(3):
            for name,fn in providers[aa_round%2:]+providers[:aa_round%2]:
                warm=[fn(aa,bb) for _ in range(200)]
                torch.flagos.synchronize()
                del warm
                for roi in range(5):
                    keep=[]
                    queue_gate[(1,)](gate,100000000,num_warps=1)
                    label='correction:case={}:provider={}:aa={}:roi={}'.format(row,name,aa_round,roi)
                    annotation.roctxRangePushA(label.encode())
                    for _ in range(200):keep.append(fn(aa,bb))
                    torch.flagos.synchronize()
                    annotation.roctxRangePop()
                    accuracy=verify(keep[-1],reference,dtype)
                    assert accuracy['ok'],(label,accuracy)
                    out.write(json.dumps(dict(case=row,seed=seed,provider=name,aa=aa_round,roi=roi,
                        calls=200,shape=record['shape'],a_offset=record['a_offset'],b_offset=record['b_offset'],
                        input_dtype=str(dtype),accuracy=accuracy,selected=record['selected']))+'\n')
                print('SCOPE_PROFILE',row,name,aa_round,flush=True)
        del keep
print('MM_SCOPE_LONG_COMPLETE',flush=True)
